description: This file defines the 'HTMLPurifier_URIScheme_ftp' class, which handles validation and configuration for FTP URIs within the HTMLPurifier library. It specifies default properties for the FTP scheme and implements the doValidate method to parse and validate URI components according to RFC 1738.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIScheme_ftp
classes.description: Class responsible for handling FTP URI validation and attributes within the HTMLPurifier framework.

methods.name: doValidate
methods.description: Validates and processes the FTP URI, specifically handling typecodes and encoding issues as defined by RFC 1738.
